title: Stevie Nicks Performs at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding at Madison Square Garden
summary: The pop superstar and NFL player tied the knot in NYC on July 3.
contentText:
Stevie Nicks brought a legendary touch to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ‘s wedding.

The iconic Fleetwood Mac singer performed during the superstar couple’s wedding at Madison Square Garden in New York City on Friday (July 3), Good Morning America co-anchor Robin Roberts confirmed during Saturday’s broadcast. Roberts and her GMA colleagues, George Stephanopoulos and Michael Strahan, were among the guests in attendance.

“We can confirm that Stevie Nicks did perform,” Roberts said on the show.

Swift also took part in a soundcheck with Nicks at Madison Square Garden earlier Friday, according to The New York Times .

It was unclear at press time which songs Nicks performed during the ceremony or whether Swift joined the iconic singer onstage.

Swift and Nicks have shared a close friendship for years. The two performed together at the 2010 Grammy Awards, and Nicks later contributed a poem titled “For T — and me” to Swift’s The Tortured Poets Department , which appears in physical editions of the album. Swift also referenced Nicks on “Clara Bow,” the closing track on the standard edition of her 2024 album.

Following Swift and Kelce’s engagement, Nicks praised the couple in an interview with Rolling Stone , saying, “She’s in a good place right now, and I think she has a good man.”

Reflecting on the ceremony, GMA ‘s Stephanopoulos said, “It was as intimate as it could possibly be, given that it was Madison Square Garden,” describing the venue as having “a garden inside the Garden that was so beautiful.”

He continued, “It’s hard to imagine a place that big and a wedding with such stars could feel so personal.”

Roberts also revealed that Swift and Kelce wrote their own vows, while Stephanopoulos shared that the couple held “little books” as they stood together at the altar. Strahan summed up the celebration by calling it their “dream wedding.”

Actor-comedian Adam Sandler officiated the ceremony , according to a statement the pop superstar’s representative shared with Billboard . The Wedding Singer star also performed a humorous yet heartfelt original song celebrating the couple’s love, TMZ reported.

Although the couple welcomed an A-list guest list , they opted not to have traditional bridesmaids or groomsmen. Instead, Swift’s brother, Austin Swift, served as her man of honor, while Jason Kelce was his brother’s best man.

The pop superstar and football player wore custom Christian Dior Haute Couture designs for the ceremony.

Shortly after the couple exchanged vows, the giant screens outside MSG announced that they had both said “I do.” “JUST&T MARRIED!” the screens read.

Among the many celebrities spotted arriving at the venue were Jack Antonoff, Mariska Hargitay, Ed Sheeran, the Haim sisters, Benson Boone and Camila Cabello.

The Kansas City Chiefs tight end proposed to the 14-time Grammy winner in August 2025. They announced their engagement in a joint Instagram post, writing, “Your English teacher and your gym teacher are getting married!”
